title: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract
summary: Declare and enforce bitemporal, PII, retention and audit lifecycle flags without redesigning the general schema engine.

criteria: An ArcheType declares exactly four lifecycle flag families: bitemporal, pii, retention and audit, each with a declared value and a declaring version.
A lifecycle flag declaration is separated from its enforcement: this contract fixes what a flag means and what enforcement it obliges, while the engine that stores records applies it.
Flag defaults are default-restrictive: an undeclared pii or retention flag is treated as the most protective value, never as unrestricted.
A bitemporal declaration obliges valid-time and transaction-time preservation, so an update never destroys the prior state of a flagged ArcheType.
Every flag declaration is tenant-aware, and a flag may only be relaxed by an explicit approved change, never as a side effect of a schema edit.
schema engine redesign is excluded: this contract adds a flag vocabulary over the existing engine and never redefines field typing, storage or projection.

risks.desc: A schema edit that quietly clears a pii, retention or audit flag would remove a legal protection from live data without any review or record.
risks.mitigation: Require an explicit approved change with an audit record for every relaxation, and prove refusal of an unreviewed relaxation with a dedicated negative.

risks.desc: Treating an undeclared pii or retention flag as unrestricted would leave newly created ArcheTypes unprotected precisely when nobody has reviewed them.
risks.mitigation: Fix resolution at default-restrictive for every undeclared flag and prove the protective default with a dedicated negative.

risks.desc: An in-place update on a bitemporal-flagged ArcheType would destroy the prior valid-time or transaction-time state that an audit or dispute depends on.
risks.mitigation: Bind the bitemporal flag to valid-time and transaction-time preservation, keep declarations append-only and require a replay comparison as evidence.

risks.desc: A lifecycle flag contract could be misread as authority to redesign field typing, storage or projection, duplicating the schema engine.
risks.mitigation: Keep schema engine redesign an explicit exclusion in every phase, declare flags over the existing engine only, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: An ArcheType declares exactly four lifecycle flag families, bitemporal, pii, retention and audit, each with a declared value and a declaring version.
Girdi is an ArcheType reference plus a tenant context; çıktı is the resolved flag set with the enforcement each flag obliges of the storage engine.
Declaration and enforcement are split: this contract fixes what a flag means, and the engine that stores records applies it.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Default-restrictive resolution is the primary control: an undeclared pii or retention flag is treated as the most protective value, so an unreviewed ArcheType is never unprotected.
Relaxing a flag requires an explicit approved change with an audit record of the prior and new value, so protection cannot be weakened as a side effect of a schema edit.
The audit flag obliges an append-only record of every change to a flagged ArcheType, including the flag change itself, which keeps a protection history as a denetim trail.
Flag declarations are tenant-aware, so a cross-tenant flag read or override is refused rather than silently applied, which preserves izolasyon.
The pii flag is the entry point for KVKK/GDPR obligations, so it drives classification, minimisation and erasure duties rather than being a descriptive label.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed flag resolution katman for all four families rather than a separate resolver per family, so defaults cannot diverge.
Flag resolution and default application stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a datastore.
Declaration and enforcement stay separated; ölü kod and speculative extra flag families are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The flag family set is closed and versioned, so introducing a new family is a reviewed contract change rather than something a declaration can invent.
Least ayrıcalık applies to flag changes: tightening a flag may follow the ordinary review path while relaxing one always requires a step-up approval.
A flag resolution is cheap and cacheable per ArcheType version, so enforcement is never skipped for performance reasons on a hot write path.

The declaration yüzey stays kapalı: flag values come from a closed enum with no free-text escape, and the resolver has no egress path that could import a flag value from outside the reviewed declaration.
securityOptimization.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: closed versioned flag family set, asymmetric tighten versus relax approval, cacheable resolution so enforcement is never skipped. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for resolving the full flag set of one ArcheType version; no measurement is claimed here.
Flag resolution sits on every write path for a flagged ArcheType, so the budget treats it as a hot lookup cached per ArcheType version.
Resolution must avoid N+1 access; the four flag families are resolved in one lookup rather than once per family.
performance.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budget for full flag-set resolution, version-cached hot path, N+1-free family resolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client must honour a pii or retention flag on data it caches; a cihaz may not retain flagged content beyond the declared retention value.
An offline client treats a bitemporal-flagged record as read-mostly and marks it stale rather than resolving a conflicting update locally.
No mobile flag administration surface is introduced here; rendering a flag state stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: device-side honouring of pii and retention flags, stale handling of bitemporal records, no mobile flag administration. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future flag administration surface must present each declared flag and its declaring version as keyboard navigable content with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
A refused flag relaxation must be announced through an aria live region naming the flag and the approval it requires, not merely disabled without explanation.
This contract defines declaration semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable flag presentation, announced relaxation refusals, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future topology for a flag resolution service remains human-developer work.
Declaring or tightening a flag is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a container rebuild; rollback returns to the previous declaring version.

A rollback here withdraws flag-declaration planning text and the projections generated from it and nothing else, so no enforced record is affected, runtimeDataImpact reads none and the NO-GO verdict does not move.
deployment.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, flag declaration as an approved data change, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A flag change olay may notify the storage engine to re-evaluate enforcement, but this contract never performs a business action of its own.
A flag change that triggers a downstream re-evaluation forms a chain that stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a protection change cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same flag change event for the same declaring version must be idempotent, and any relaxation always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: flag change events without acting, depth-bounded re-evaluation chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated relaxation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.

AI cannot relax a lifecycle flag, cannot clear a pii or audit declaration and cannot shorten a retention value; each of those needs insan onayı, and a relaxation additionally requires a step-up review.

Any flag proposal reaching the lane as sub_prompt is untrusted, the kill switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from relaxing flags, clearing pii or audit declarations or shortening retention, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases declare all four flag families on an ArcheType and assert each obliged enforcement is reported with its declaring version, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove an undeclared pii or retention flag resolves default-restrictive rather than unrestricted.
Planned negatives prove an unapproved relaxation is refused and that a schema edit cannot clear a flag as a side effect.
Planned negatives prove a bitemporal-flagged update cannot destroy prior valid-time or transaction-time state, and that a cross-tenant override is refused.
No flag matrix may be reported as satisfied before a human-approved execution has actually happened, because planned coverage is not evidence.
testing.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: four-family declaration positives, default-restrictive negatives, unapproved relaxation negatives, bitemporal preservation and cross-tenant negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A04 insecure design is the defining axis: default-restrictive resolution and approval-gated relaxation are declared up front rather than added after an incident.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by keeping flag declarations tenant-aware and refusing a cross-tenant flag override.
OWASP A09 security logging failures is modeled by the audit flag, which obliges an append-only record of every change including the flag change itself.

Girdi doğrulama applies to every flag declaration: the family, value and declaring version are validated against the closed vocabulary before storage, and the audit flag guarantees a denetim izi for every change.
owasp.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A04 via default-restrictive approval-gated design, A01 via tenant-aware declarations, A09 via the audit flag's append-only obligation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-bayraklari with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-archetype-bayraklari] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a flag declaration touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; enforcement is requested as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window from 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-28; predecessor schema-metadata-engine-contract ends 2028-03-15, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly schema-metadata-engine-contract and sus-bitemporal, and the parent's related list is not inherited.
Scope stays inside the declaration layer: schema engine redesign, field typing, storage layout and projection ownership all stay outside.
integration.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-bayraklari to the same provider, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, short planning window marker and the schema engine exclusion. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir the resolved flag set through this contract and may not keep its own privacy or retention table or reach a doğrudan tablo for declarations.
A consumer must carry the declaring version alongside any stored decision that depended on a flag, so a later audit can tell which protection was in force.
Typing a field and storing a record belong to schema-metadata-engine-contract; this contract declares lifecycle obligations only.
moduleUsage.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated flag resolution without local privacy tables or direct table reads, declaring version carried with stored decisions, excluded typing and storage authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: This contract is the platform's lifecycle compliance anchor, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are expressed as declared flags; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
The retention flag sets the saklama süresi for a flagged ArcheType, and the pii flag obliges classification and minimisation before any record is created under it.
Flag declarations are retained append-only so a historical protection level stays explainable, and stored declarations evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: flags as the compliance anchor, retention and pii obligations, append-only declaration history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include flag resolution latency percentiles, default-restrictive fallback counts by family and refused relaxation counts on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the ArcheType reference and declaring version; flagged record content and pii payloads are redacted and never become metric labels.

Alerts cover a spike in default-restrictive fallbacks after a schema change, any relaxation attempt without approval and any bitemporal enforcement failure; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: resolution and fallback SLIs, redacted version-scoped traces, unapproved-relaxation and bitemporal-failure alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unreachable declaration store during resolution; the contract degrades to the default-restrictive value, never to an unrestricted one.
Resolution is idempotent by construction: the same ArcheType at the same declaring version always resolves to the same flag set, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot weaken protection.
A repeatedly failing flag change is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than retried forever, and a circuit breaker protects the shared resolver.
reliability.notes: archetype-lifecycle-flags-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: ArcheType Lifecycle Flags Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-restrictive degradation on store failure, idempotent resolution with bounded retry, dead-letter routing and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
